result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but a few visual defects stand out: a nonsensical '−100%' discount badge on the pizza card, inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) button between the two large restaurant cards, and low-contrast placeholder text in the search field. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff were treated as expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The pizza card's promo badge reads '−100%', which is not a meaningful discount value (a negative 100% discount implies the item is free or is a formatting/sign error). It also differs in format from the other badge ('€0 delivery'), suggesting a data or template bug.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering and format them consistently (e.g., '-20%' or '100% off'). Suppress or replace badges with invalid values like −100%.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently across cards: on the pizza card it sits inside a dark translucent circular background, while on the Tokumaru Ramen card the heart appears without any circular container, making it look unfinished and reducing its visibility against varied imagery.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular scrim/background to the heart button on all restaurant cards so the control is consistently visible and recognizable regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') and magnifier icon are light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text/icon to reach at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the field background, or use a darker field surface.
